messages:
incident-bot: [P1] ALERT: Inference API (generation) errors spike > 60% across us-west-2 for 5m. Pages sent to #oncall. service=inference-api component=runtime
Alex P: oncall here, investigating. seeing 504s from model pool, starting tail of logs and checking node health.
Alex P: running: `kubectl -n inference logs -l app=inference-runtime --since=10m | grep ERROR | head -n 40`
Josh L: i can grab kernel-level metrics, giving me 2m to attach GPU perf counters.
Maria G: i'll open a jumpbox to the affected AZ and verify network path. also pinging infra for recent deploys.
Alex P: quick check — model host cpu near 100%, mem ok, lots of kernel stalls. looks like a hot loop during KV cache eviction. throttling requests to fallback model v1-quant while we investigate. @ir-manager heads-up to customer-facing on-call.
ir-manager: noted, pinging status page + support triage. I already drafted a short message: "We are investigating increased error rates for text-generation in us-west-2; mitigation in progress." want approval to post?
Alex P: post it, include mitigation (fallback to v1-quant) and ETA 15-30m. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Automated action: route policy applied -> 30% traffic -> model=v1-quant fallback. ruleset=auto-fallback-2026-03
Sam T: can we confirm which customers hit errors? I'll run `SELECT customer_id, count(*) FROM request_logs WHERE region='us-west-2' AND status >= 500 GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 10;`
Alex P: sample output (sanitized):
```
cust_284    340
cust_917    120
cust_031    45
```
These top 3 likely impacted; @ir-manager please prioritize outreach for cust_284 and cust_917.
ir-manager: will reach out. pinged CSMs and started a private thread with affected customer contacts.
Maria G: found a recent kernel change landed in runtime yesterday (PR #4321) that changes KV eviction heuristics. reverting to previous commit on one pool now for canary.
Josh L: applying revert on 3 nodes now. tails show error rate dropping on those nodes.
Alex P: traffic shifted back, overall error rate trending down to normal. keeping fallback in place for 10 more mins and then will remove.
incident-bot: Incident status -> Mitigated by fallback + partial rollback. Incident ID=INC-20260315-42.
Alex P: removing fallback now. monitoring.
Alex P: looks stable across AZs, latency and error rate within SLOs. marking as resolved in 5m unless regress.
incident-bot: Incident INC-20260315-42: RESOLVED at 1831459920. Duration 53m.
ir-manager: thanks. scheduling postmortem—propose 2026-03-17 15:00 UTC (30m). who can attend?
Maria G: I can do 15:00 UTC. putting notes in the postmortem doc.
Josh L: available. will bring kernel metrics and revert timeline.
Alex P: available. will prepare timeline + mitigation steps (fallback config, autoscaling gaps).
Sam T: can do 15:00 UTC. I'll prepare a short customer impact table (counts + SLA calc).
ir-manager: created postmortem doc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026-42-pm (placeholder) — please add action items there.
Alex P: initial action items I’ll add now:
- ACTION: Add a pre-deploy smoke check that validates KV eviction under high-concurrency (owner: Alex P, ETA: 2026-03-31)
- ACTION: Add alert for kernel stall metrics crossing threshold (owner: Josh L, ETA: 2026-03-24)
- ACTION: Update rollback runbook to include quick revert steps for PRs touching eviction logic (owner: Maria G, ETA: 2026-03-22)
Sam T: customer impact summary (from logs):
```
- cust_284: 340 failed requests, window 2026-03-15T10:14-11:07 UTC, estimated successful tokens lost ~ 125k
- cust_917: 120 failed requests, window same, estimated tokens ~ 42k
- cust_031: 45 failed
```
Estimated total impacted tokens ~ 170k.
Sam T: rough SLA credit calc: our SLI target is 99.9% monthly availability. this incident pushed uptime for affected customers below their contracted threshold for the window. preliminary estimate: credit = min($5k, usage-proportional) -> filing formal calc with finance.
ir-manager: tagging finance ops. @finance-ops we need help creating a customer-facing SLA credit estimate and guidance on issuing credits for INC-20260315-42. affected accounts: cust_284, cust_917, cust_031.
finance-ops: acknowledged. please next steps: share finalized usage windows and invoice IDs for the affected accounts. we'll create FIN-4598 to track and propose credit amounts. ETA 3 business days for initial proposal.
Alex P: added the exact request_log export to the PM doc (anonymized).
Sam T: created a billing export snippet for cust_284: `aws s3 cp s3://billing-exports/2026-03/usage_cust_284.csv .` includes token counts and charges.
ir-manager: agreed action list for follow-ups:
- ACTION: Postmortem writeup and publish to incidents (owner: ir-manager, ETA: 2026-03-18)
- ACTION: Finance credit estimate (owner: finance-ops, ticket FIN-4598, ETA: 2026-03-20)
- ACTION: Customer outreach follow-ups & SLA credit offer (owner: ir-manager + CSMs, ETA: 2026-03-19)
- ACTION: Runtime unit test for KV eviction (owner: Maria G, ETA: 2026-03-28)

Josh L: logging note — we should add more granular logs around eviction decisions (low overhead) before next deploy. will add to backlog.
finance-ops: FIN-4598 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-4598. initial comment: "Investigate INC-20260315-42 impact and propose SLA credits for cust_284, cust_917, cust_031. Need invoice IDs + usage exports." assigned to @finance-ops.
ir-manager: thanks — i'll update customers after finance proposes numbers. any other blockers?
Alex P: none from ops. recommend we run a full canary for eviction revert next week and incrementally re-enable new heuristic once smoke tests pass.
Sam T: adding a quick synthetic test to our CI that replays a 1k-request KV-heavy trace. will link PR in postmortem.
Maria G: adding timeline + commit ids to PM doc.
ir-manager: closing thread for now. please continue updates in the PM doc and the FIN ticket. if anything changes ping this thread. :white_check_mark:
